package.reference_changes: Document visible curve endpoint checks and prefer one multiline same-style label; runtime unchanged.

semantic_review.scope: Explicit groups preserve nested native leaves, paint order and source geometry; recursive native QA checks membership and every leaf. Multi-parent/cycle/depth/count constraints bound grouping input. No added external process or network capability; existing paths and render boundaries unchanged. Flat/grouped actual pixels and saved-document edits independently verified on two new raster-source figures and one existing complex figure. User-edit granularity uses whole labels, necessary formula parts, per-curve groups and nested modules. No automatic semantic grouping, external-arrow routing, original chart-data recovery or Office equations. Native PowerPoint/WPS UI not tested. Source typography remains approximate; Avenir subfamily failure preserved, blocking check not weakened.
